Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The Parisian league has ended yesterday with a victory of Antonio Cobo-Cuenca.
He wins a second time the title of Sénéchal de Paris, after 2007.

The league was not oriented towards the Arrondissement as the previous leagues. It was too much hassle, and since I started the league half way during the year, I wanted to keep it simple and to encourage people to play different games each time.

Thus was born the Diversity league.

Rules:

In order to compute each player's points, proceed by clan (a deck using a "star" vampire uses his or her clan) and take the best score for each clan.
The sum of these best scores gives the player's total points.

Eg. Vincent plays 15 times a Baali deck, and his best score with that clan is GW 4. He scores 4 points (GW is irrelevant, this will be changed next year).
Tim plays once a Malkavian deck (1,5 VP), 7 times a Tremere deck (best score GW 3)
and twice a turbo Una deck (!Gangrel) (best score 1 VP). He scores 1,5 + 3 + 1 = 5,5 points.

In order to win the title, one must play the most possible different decks and score with each (possibly playing the same clan a few times to improve that clan's score).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
